item.subject: science
item.stem:
Javed wants to test whether warm or cold conditions change how fast water moves up a plant stem. He has two similar cut twigs, some with flowers and some without, and two glasses of red-coloured water.

Which plan is a fair test?

options.A: Put one twig in a warm place and the other in a cold place, keeping twig size, water amount and light the same.
options.B: Put a short twig in the warm place and a long twig in the cold place, then see which turns red first.
options.C: Use only a twig without flowers, because a twig with flowers cannot show water transport.
options.D: Choose the twig whose leaves look darkest red, even if those leaves turned red later.
